identity_cost.detail: a registered business with its own email domain: the trial policy admits only "Doanh Nghi p" (businesses) that have never used the platform and requires the customer to supply full business details and a corporate email domain, and the live trial form requires "Full Name", "Your Company email", "Phone", "Company Name" and "Job Title". So a company, a company email domain and a phone number are all required; no card or hold is stated, and debit or prepaid do not arise because the trial credit is free. The policy text still says the programme ends 2023-12-31 while the form is live
